statement: VAT registration is compulsory when total taxable turnover for the last 12 months goes over £90,000 (the VAT threshold) or when taxable turnover is expected to go over £90,000 in the next 30 days; in the 12-month case the business must register within 30 days of the end of the month in which it went over the threshold, with registration effective from the first day of the second month after going over.
caveat: The threshold figure changes at fiscal events and the forward-looking test carries its own deadline and effective date (the date the business realised it would go over). Verify the current figure and timing on GOV.UK before relying.
